title: App store keyword research for the Zedu app on Google Play and the App Store, for Nigerian educators
description: No task covers app store search (T-1569 rewrote the listing text but did no keyword research). Using free tools and the stores' own search suggestions with the region set to Nigeria, deliver: (1) 30 keywords that bootcamp operators, instructors and learners type (for example 'cohort app', 'class communication app', 'bootcamp app'), each with its source, and a difficulty note based on the top 5 apps ranking for it; (2) a recommended App Store title (30 chars), subtitle (30 chars) and keyword field (100 chars), plus a Google Play title and short description (80 chars), with the keywords placed; (3) the top 5 competing education or community apps for the main terms, with their titles; (4) a dated before snapshot of where Zedu ranks today for 10 key terms, so the change can be measured later. Use only claims that appear on https://zedu.chat/; mark anything else 'needs confirmation'. Don't mention Telex, Enterprise prices, per-student billing or named integrations. Nothing is published or sent without team approval.
rationale: The site points visitors to the Zedu app on both stores, and the brief focuses on acquiring bootcamps in Nigeria. Ranking in Nigerian store search turns people already looking for a cohort tool into Starter sign-ups.
